name: Shivneri Caves
description: Shivneri Caves are a group of ancient Buddhist rock-cut caves near the famous Shivneri Fort, birthplace of Chhatrapati Shivaji Maharaj. The caves date back to the 1st century BCE and feature viharas, chaityas, and intricate carvings.
historicalSignificance: Important Buddhist site, contemporary with other Deccan cave complexes. Associated with early trade routes and monastic life.
reviews: A hidden gem for history and archaeology lovers.
The caves are peaceful and less crowded than other sites.
Combine with a visit to Shivneri Fort.
